result.summary: Found 1 major issue: truncated content in the restaurant carousel that prevents full visibility of restaurant information.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off horizontally, showing only 'Trattoria Piccol' (truncated name) and partial visibility of the delivery time badge. The card extends beyond the visible viewport without clear indication of horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Either adjust the carousel to show complete card content with proper spacing, implement a visible scroll indicator to show there are more items, or adjust the layout to display fewer items per row to ensure all content is fully visible without truncation.
